d: France witnessed another wave of protests on November 14 as thousands took to the streets over the rising cost of living, education and public services. In Paris, demonstrators marched across streets, where riot police fired tear gas to disperse protesters as tensions escalated. Students, trade unions, Yellow Vest activists and workers united over a range of demands, including better school infrastructure, more teachers, improved university admissions and stronger child protection.
